extra.reason: All acceptance criteria met: build, lint, and test pass cleanly (89 tests, 0 errors). ESM TypeScript package scaffolded with port interfaces (Clock, FileSystem, Lock, IdGenerator, EventSink) and structured result/error conventions. No Pi or concrete provider dependencies in core. Tests use deterministic fakes (FakeClock, FakeFileSystem, etc.). Documentation updated (CONTRACTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md).

All acceptance criteria met: (1) Repeated init preserves user edits via idempotent workspace creation. (2) Discovery skips malformed/untrusted paths with machine-readable diagnostics. (3) Created workspaces validate against contracts with structural validation. (4) 29 unit tests cover success and failure paths for slugs, path defense, init, and discovery. (5) CONTRACTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md updated with workspace API docs, contract adapter boundary, and path safety guidance.

Settings resolution: deterministic inheritance (system→channel→series→episode), null=reset-to-system-default, undefined=keep-existing, resolution report with provenance and resets. 6 tests including golden fixture.

Pipeline inheritance resolver: extends chain with cycle/depth guards, stage merge (override/remove via !id marker), Kahn topological sort with cycle detection, artifact producer/consumer flow validation, in-memory fixture loader. Deterministic regardless of declaration order. 19 new tests, 180 total.

Pipeline snapshots: content-addressed immutable production contract. Includes resolved pipeline, settings, provider bindings, source refs, skill IDs. SHA-256 deterministic hashing with sorted-key serialization. In-memory SnapshotStore for testing. Snapshots are immutable—supersede by creating a new version. 17 new tests, 197 total.

Atomic revisioned artifact storage: SHA-256 revision IDs, CAS writes through temp+fsync+rename, conflict diagnostics with diff summaries, revision history sidecar, in-memory mutation queue per canonical path. Preserves original content on conflict. 13 new tests, 210 total.

Append-only JSONL journal: monotonic sequence, SHA-256 content hashing for corruption detection, truncated-line recovery, atomic append (read+append+atomicWrite), resumable reader with cursor support, projections for stage/artifact/budget/review/snapshot state, merge from delta replay. 15 new tests, 225 total.

Stage state machine with valid transition enforcement, lease acquisition/release through Lock port, retry guards (max 3 attempts), and StageExecutor driving stages in topological order. Records stage.started/completed/failed to journal. 15 new tests, 240 total.

Artifact dependency graph with BFS downstream/upstream traversal, cycle detection via DFS, and staleness propagation engine. Script edit fixture correctly marks narration/captions/timing/render stale. Asset selection only marks render. Acceptance and clear. 14 new tests, 254 total.
